title: Less Fleece, More Fake material
text: Less Fleece, More Fake material. This blanket isn't exactly what I expected for a "fleece" of sorts.  It's still soft, but I decided to pivot and used this as a tree skirt, which looked perfect.  I know that sounds weird, but I have a new pet that was doomed to destroy my previous tree skirt.  While it wasn't as expected, I do like the use I got out of it.
